name: start-here
tagline_zh: 别让AI瞎猜你的生意。先花10分钟访谈创始人，生成一份专属brief，让所有后续建议都基于你的真实业务。
tagline_en: Stop generic advice. Interview the founder once, generate a brief that grounds every skill in your real.
desc_en: Interview the founder once and write a docs/gtm-cofounder/founder-brief.md that every other skill reads first, so the advice is about their real business, not a textbook. Use this before anything else, or whenever the agent lacks context on the founder's product, ICP, market, or stage, or is giving generic GTM advice.
why_zh: 同类工具直接给模板，它先挖你的底细再定制，确保每句建议都长在你的业务上。
why_en: Unlike template-dumpers, it mines your context first, so every recommendation is rooted in your actual business, not generic.
